- No reported erythema or warmth — further argues against infection or inflammatory arthropathy.

[GAPS]

- Status of PIP joint flexion is not specified — important because preserved PIP flexion supports isolated FDP (not FDS) involvement.  
- MRI results are pending — definitive confirmation of FDP tendon discontinuity or retraction is missing.  
- Palpation for a palpable tendon gap or nodule in the palm or proximal finger — a supportive but not always present finding — was not reported.

[DIAGNOSIS]  
Jersey finger (flexor digitorum profundus tendon avulsion)
